scientific_limitations: For gamma>1, the normalization series diverges, but the basin biholomorphism type remains undetermined. The result neither proves a third biholomorphism type nor asserts a universal threshold for arbitrary critical sequences.
scientific_summary: The dyadic q_n=(2^n/n)(n/2^floor(log_2 n))^gamma family realizes successive quotient limit points 2^(1-gamma) and 2 at root scale 2. Its derivative-normalization series is summable exactly for 0<gamma<=1. All basins are parabolic, and the summable-side basins are biholomorphic to C^2.
source_relationship: Geometric basin consequences apply the published sufficient conditions in Boc Thaler (arXiv:2610.00627v1); the family-specific quotient and summability calculations are provided in RESULT.md.
title: A sharp quotient-floor phase boundary for critical non-autonomous Hénon basins
